## PI0269 completed UNIFORM main64: reference drift, tracking, and acquisition are separated

Source evidence commit: c1f067b2cf0ae88371436d20345661069aef21e2. Original PI0269 release e77ad092406555645fb8c68ba34cc8594ef18ee6 / authority5964897978 remains the running contract. This is a completed single-point saved-array analysis, not the final three-point verdict.

All64 UNIFORM main episodes and every saved0..40s tick were hash-checked and analyzed, with unchanged original static terminal targets and original reliability predicate. No model, gradient, teacher, renderer or physics call was added.

M1 original success31/32; all31 subsequently exit the original pose bounds. Median interval from original completion to first later exit4.9s. Median final40s XYZ distance over all32 conditions220.400mm. E0 has zero same-tick position tracking discrepancy over all32 E0 cases (angular numerical maximum3.65e-8rad); its15 successful M1 cases still exit. E1 maximum tracking error over all32 E1 cases3.948mm/.029299rad; its16 successful M1 cases also exit. Persistent target departure thus occurs even with exact E0 position tracking; it is not established as a WBC installation fault or a unique neural cause.

M3 original success0/32, broad-ready0/32, angular entry0/32, maximum ordered bins0; median terminal-target distance57.580mm. Reverse/shortcut counters are inactive without entry and must not be presented as proof that no abnormal motion occurred.

Actual figure: first frozen EVAL family, all four M1 command/backend conditions, all late40s motion. Reference-to-target, achieved-to-target, and reference-to-achieved are separately plotted at identical ticks; XYZ and SO3 units, original bounds, first completion/exit, and35..40s reliability window are explicit. VIRTUAL MATHEMATICAL EXECUTOR / NOT WBC / NOT PHYSICS watermark. Main-owner visual inspection passed; no independent reviewer is claimed. PNG SHA188219544737c53aace180a554b496320420e1046949ae64949ace636def789f; full64 CSV SHA5d08eed3ffe1f53099b143513b40a3d8cf363fce1263e2f0e7d070bfa768b8e0.

Sources: reports/PI0269/uniform-reference-analysis/README.md, UNIFORM_MAIN64_REFERENCE_TRACKING_DRIFT.csv, UNIFORM_REFERENCE_TRACKING_DRIFT_RECEIPT.json, actual PNG and VISUAL_QA.json. A CPU-only import-path error was minimally fixed in the isolated analysis helper. The unsealed archiver's suffix list now includes PNG so this scientific evidence is retained in the eventual summary tar as well as direct public files; weight/private asset suffixes remain excluded. CPU boundary check verified35/35 frozen evaluation source hashes unchanged and zero uploads/queries.

Actual driver PID3611282 remains healthy; latest checked PREFIX20/64, UNIFORM64/64, component0/96. Keep the same evaluator and complete all fixed conditions; no quality retry, cancelled arm or changed scorer. Concurrent PI0270 source commits were preserved by a non-force rebase; no moving Git checkout was synced into the frozen evaluator.

Still required: complete PREFIX64 and all96 diagnostic proposals, full native CPU replay and three-point same-tick analysis, failure-preserving videos, new result HF fixed-revision readbacks and final budget/completion audit. Old FAIL/WBC PARTIAL and selected/deployment NONE preserved; no new WBC/physics/scenes/mail/monitor/PR77 pointer/merge.
